caption: OMIM facts conveyed for the same papers when their full text is hidden (46 entries, 136 curator paragraphs about the hidden papers; the same 2,120 facts judged in each condition). For papers readable in full, the full text was hidden and the entry was written by direct reading from the abstract alone, or from the abstract plus second-hand passages from later open-access papers that cite it; these are compared with the direct-reading draft written from the full text. Coverage is scored against the same fixed fact lists as the main comparison and counts present facts plus half of partly present ones; contradicted facts (4, 10 and 10) are too few to see. Right: paired difference in per-entry coverage from the abstract-only draft, with bootstrap 95% intervals over entries. The full-text draft went through the audit's repair round; the two new drafts did not. With the papers held fixed, coverage was 77.4% from the full text and 31.2% from the abstracts alone (paired difference +43.9 points; 45 of 46 entries higher with full text); adding second-hand passages raised abstract-only coverage by 4.9 points (33 of 46 entries higher).
description: Horizontal stacked bars of fact counts (x = 0 to 2,120), one per condition, from experimental_log.md Sec. 6.2 table 'OMIM-fact coverage on the frozen fact lists (main measure)': Abstract only 495 present / 331 partial / 1,290 absent / 4 contradicted; Abstract + second-hand passages 629 / 297 / 1,184 / 10; Full text 1,513 / 254 / 343 / 10. Coverage at bar end 31.2% / 36.7% / 77.4%. Right column: paired differences from abstract only from the table under it: +4.9 pp (+2.8 to +7.1), entries 33 better / 9 worse / 4 tied; +43.9 pp (+38.5 to +49.3), 45 / 0 / 1. Colours matched to fig_missed_facts (present #009E73, partly #E69F00, absent #BBBBBB, contradicted #000000). 5.5 x 3.1 in, 300 dpi.
